name: Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc.
summary: Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc. provides investor communications and technology-driven solutions for the financial services industry in the United States and internationally. The company's Investor Communication Solutions segment handles the proxy materials distribution and voting processes for bank, broker-dealer, corporate issuer, and fund clients; provides fund manager; and various other regulatory communication solutions.
